author: Eldritch RPG Team
descr: Plyphyny is an eldritch gothic horror RPG system featuring a unique Ablative Defense system with Active Defense (ADP) and Passive Defense (PDP) pools, Quick-Start Bestiary automation, and comprehensive character building. The system uses an ability tree structure (Competence, Prowess, Fortitude) with specialties and focuses, threat dice for attacks, and Battle Phase initiative.
name: Plyphyny System
shortDescr: Eldritch RPG / Plyphyny System with layered defense and QSB automation.
